title: citrus × limonia khatta
intro: Citrus × limonia khatta, commonly known as Indian lime or khatta nimbu, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It is valued for its unique flavor and aroma, which is often used in traditional Indian and Southeast Asian medicine. The health benefits of Citrus × limonia khatta include its ability to aid digestion, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a popular remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and other compounds that exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
